features.name: Authentication System
features.description: Custom authentication system with dual-mode support (plain text and hashed passwords), role-based access control (admin, to_qltb, qltb_khoa, user), department-based filtering

features.name: Equipment Management
features.description: Comprehensive medical equipment management with CRUD operations, status tracking, QR code scanning, department-based filtering, search functionality

features.name: Equipment Usage Tracking
features.description: Real-time usage logging, start/end usage sessions, mobile-optimized usage actions, active usage indicators

features.name: Repair Request Management
features.description: Department-based repair request system with authorization checks, equipment filtering, user permission validation

features.name: Maintenance Management
features.description: Maintenance planning and scheduling, maintenance plan creation and editing, maintenance task management

features.name: Transfer Management
features.description: Equipment transfer between departments, transfer request creation, transfer history tracking

features.name: User Management
features.description: Administrative user management system with role assignment, department assignment, user status tracking

features.name: Dashboard & Reporting
features.description: Interactive dashboards with equipment statistics, inventory reports, performance monitoring, data visualization with charts

features.name: Real-time Synchronization
features.description: Real-time data synchronization using Supabase realtime, equipment updates, usage logging sync

features.name: Database Schema & Migrations
features.description: PostgreSQL database schema with 9 main tables, migration scripts, performance optimization indexes

features.name: Import/Export Functionality
features.description: Excel import/export for equipment data, bulk operations, data formatting utilities

features.name: AI Integration (Future)
features.description: AI utilities and components for future features like equipment analysis, maintenance prediction

features.name: Performance Monitoring
features.description: Department-based performance tracking, system optimization monitoring, cache management

features.name: PWA & Mobile Optimization
features.description: Progressive Web App features, mobile-responsive design, offline capabilities, push notifications

features.name: Deployment & DevOps
